No existing strata or structure exists to hold this.
placements.title: system design and pipeline behavior as load-bearing requirements
placements.frame: What structural responsibilities does the system design impose, and how do its pipelines fulfill them?

placements.title: the pipeline must forge identity from content when none is given
placements.frame: What must the pipeline do when a submission arrives without explicit identity, and through what mechanisms does it produce and persist one?
placements.why: Both segments describe the pipeline's responsibility to generate a slug from memory content when no explicit ID is provided: src-1 establishes the triggering condition (submission without an explicit id field), src-2 states the required behavior (produce a slug via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback, then commit the file successfully). This is a thematic subject future envelopes will keep feeding — the pipeline's identity-generation contract — not a one-time fact.
